def update_pet(pet)
  id = key?(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = Integer(fetch(pet, :id, "id"))
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, nil)&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(:id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if true
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  data

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError)
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless id
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless self.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  data

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")

  unless @pets.key?(id)
    nil
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?

  end

    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = pet
  @pets[id] = data
  data
end

def update_pet(pet)
  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  @pets[] = data
  data
end

  id = fetch(pet, :id, "id")&.to_i
  if id.nil?
    raise(InvalidInputError, "Pet ID required for update")
  end
  unless @pets.key?(id)
    raise(NotFoundError, "Pet not found")
  end
  data = normalize_pet(pet)
  self[id] = data
  data
end

end
